d: Every employee at Al Rostamani Group plays a role in making a real difference to the business and our customers. We care for our employees by offering them meaningful and purposeful work and an opportunity to grow, learn, contribute and succeed. Today, the Al Rostamani Group has come a long way since its birth in 1957. Our group has grown steadfastly with the guiding principles of Commitment, Care & Vision, alongside a strong sense of active involvement in the community. We are a well-diversified group, with a key presence in industries such as General Trading, Automobiles and Heavy Equipment, Travel, Foreign Exchange, Financial Services, Property Management, Construction, Infrastructure Development and Information Technology Services. Our Group employs approximately 2000 people from 41 different nationalities, which contributes to our multicultural and multi-national environment.

The job holder is responsible for contributing to the monthly sales targets to ensure achievement of the team’s annual sales and customer satisfaction targets, specific to the passenger car retail business. The role involves appropriately following the sales process from actual sales to handing over to the customer, carrying out market intelligence activities and creating opportunities for acquiring new business.
q: Diploma / Bachelor Degree, preferably in Automotive industry
2 years of sales experience within the automotive industry
Excellent negotiation skills and influencing skills
Strong knowledge of product and market
Sound financial awareness and business acumen
Written and verbal communication in English (other regionally spoken languages including Arabic would be an added advantage)
Proficient in MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint

At Al Rostamani Group, we seek talented people who work hard to achieve great things. We consider not only your skills and experience, but also your passion for the role, your desire to learn and how well you align with our core values of care, commitment and vision. If this position represents an opportunity you wish to pursue, we invite you to apply.
r: Maintain an active customer profile database to ensure all relevant details are up to date when required. This includes accurate collection of customer and vehicle information and input in the Dealer Management System

Make recommendations on sales strategies and follows all steps of the sales process to attract and retain customers in the long-term. This involves range of sales process activities ranging from prospecting , generating appointments, meet and greet, consultation, presentation, negotiation, trading appraisal for used cars, objection handling, actual closure, vehicle delivery, and post sale follow-up

Conduct personal visits, understands customer’s requirements and assesses his current situation to establish needs. This includes providing technical information in relation to product performance, features, options/ application versus pricing
Negotiates optimum deals and sells vehicles at maximum margins to acquire and retain customers in the long-term and maximise company profit as per company polices

Coordinates with the concerned department member to order the vehicle in a timely manner, if it is not readily available. This includes tracking and following up on the arrival of the vehicle and updating the customer on any delays
Collect payments as per set deadlines to ensure payment is received on time and customer credit is minimised
Coordinate delivery of vehicle to customer and ensures that delivery process requirements are met in order to ensure customer satisfaction
Ensures all related documents and necessary paperwork are completed
Assists and advises customers on requirements for bank/insurance approvals
Coordinates with Service or person-in-charge for pre-delivery inspection (PDI) and timely delivery
At the time of delivery, demonstrates the vehicle’s operating features, including service, warranty, location of service center/facility, etc.)
Maintains an owner follow up system to ensure customer satisfaction and encourage repeat or referral business
Ensures vehicles are properly displayed in the showroom in coordination with the branch in charge to ensure that customers are aware of the company’s products
Prepares reports such as weekly plans, activity and results reports and those relate to issues resolution to present and review with management

d: We’re looking for a Senior Marketing Officer to help shape how Ideal Solutions is positioned, recognized, and experienced in the market.

This is a strategic marketing role for someone who can look beyond day-to-day execution and connect marketing with business growth, market intelligence, corporate positioning, and competitive advantage.

You’ll work closely with executive management, Sales, Business Development, and technical teams to turn market insights into meaningful marketing strategies — with a strong focus on B2B and B2G markets.
q: You’re a senior marketer who combines strategic thinking with strong execution.
r: Develop and lead strategic marketing plans aligned with business growth and market expansion.
Strengthen Ideal Solutions’ corporate positioning, value proposition, and market visibility.
Lead market intelligence and competitor analysis to identify opportunities and emerging trends.
Plan and execute integrated campaigns across digital, content, events, communications, and PR.
Support B2B and government-focused initiatives, including proposals, tenders, presentations, and strategic account targeting.
Strengthen our digital presence through website, SEO, analytics, and data-driven marketing.
Build thought leadership and corporate visibility across relevant markets.
Lead employer branding initiatives that strengthen our position as an employer of choice.
Measure marketing performance and translate data into actionable recommendations.
7+ years of senior marketing experience, preferably within the IT industry.
A Bachelor’s degree in Marketing or a related field.
Strong experience across both digital and traditional marketing.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in Arabic and English, including presentation and public speaking.
Strong analytical, project management, and organizational skills.
Experience with marketing analytics, CRM, content management, and campaign performance measurement.
Experience planning and managing events and working with internal and external stakeholders.
The ability to turn market insights and data into clear marketing strategies.

At Ideal Solutions, we believe great work starts with creating the right environment for people to thrive. We foster a culture built on trust, collaboration, innovation, and wellbeing, where people are encouraged to bring their ideas, grow their skills, and enjoy the journey along the way.
We’re proud to be recognized as a Great Place to Work® 2026 and to offer a workplace where high performance, innovation, and a strong sense of community go hand in hand.
If strategic marketing, market influence, and meaningful business impact are what you’re looking for in your next role, we’d like to meet you.
